free_tier.stated: 100 GB assets + 100 GB bandwidth/month per project; no maximum number of projects per account

egress.terms: 100 GB/month CDN bandwidth included per project, hard cap on Free (no overage purchase). Assets served from cdn.sanity.io with on-the-fly transforms.

tooling: sanity CLI (`sanity dataset create`, `sanity assets upload`), @sanity/client HTTP API; assets land on cdn.sanity.io with stable public URLs
chaining: Account has NO cap on project count ('no maximum limit on the number of projects you can have in a Sanity account' — Sanity's own answers page). Each project = 2 datasets x 100 GB assets. N projects x 200 GB. Multiply the account layer again with separate Google/GitHub logins. This is the single best multiplier.
limits_note: 2 datasets per project; 10k documents/project; 100 GB assets and 100 GB bandwidth are HARD caps (Free allows no overage — asset API is blocked at quota); 20 user seats.
reliability_note: Free projects are hard-capped, not throttled: at 100 GB bandwidth the CDN returns errors until the calendar month resets. Asset URLs are public and permanent; no expiry observed.
